Payments - When you are charged
Your card is charged when the order ships, not when the order is placed. A temporary authorization hold may appear at checkout and drops off within 3 business days.
</document>

Gift Cards - Expiry and refunds
Brindlewick Audio gift cards never expire. Gift cards cannot be refunded, returned, or exchanged for cash.
